description: This Java class 'FeedbackDBUtil' interacts with a database to retrieve and insert feedback records. It provides static methods for fetching all feedback entries and inserting new feedback into the database.

classes.name: FeedbackDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class for database operations related to Feedback objects, providing methods to retrieve and insert feedback data.

methods.name: getAllFeedbacks
methods.description: Retrieves all feedback entries from the database and returns them as a list of Feedback objects.

methods.name: insertFeedback
methods.description: Inserts a new feedback record into the database with specified comments, rating, and OID.
